|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E3 (version 4 of 4) of the Virtual Modern card. It is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-D-agentkallus_ai.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V3-D-agentkallus_ai-2022-12-12-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V3-D-agentkallus_ai-2022-01-15.gif]], 15 January 2022) → [[File:V3-D-agentkallus_ai-2022-12-12-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V3-D-agentkallus_ai.gif]], 12 December 2022). '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark, but this is errata 3 in release order; the mark is recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Agent Kallus (ALT)]]): PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-agentkallus_ai91ca80c">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/agentkallus_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 commit 91ca80c] (18 February 2021); the PC no longer serves it (the next day the PC moved this PNG to the repository's “hires” folder and published a GIF made from it). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Imperial Trooper Guard”. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and place the other in Used Pile. While with an ISB agent, adds one battle destiny.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Agent Kallus (ALT) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 19 February 2021<ref name="img-agentkallus_ai83cacba">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/agentkallus_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/83cacbafbf6096e6be059d69fda34cf93fe24c68 commit 83cacba] (19 February 2021); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/agentkallus_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). '''What changed:''' the PC replaced its high-resolution PNG upload of the day before with the GIF made from it for Holotable (the PNG was moved to the “hires” folder); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (703×980 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Imperial Trooper Guard”. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots.
